question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s extensive consolidation of power since 2012, including abolition of presidential term limits and repeated purges of rivals in the CCP and PLA, underpins trader consensus that he will remain in office through the end of 2026. Recent military leadership changes, continued emphasis on national security, and active policy direction on energy and foreign affairs through mid-2026 have reinforced perceptions of stability with no visible succession process underway. The implied probability above 95 percent for remaining in power reflects this entrenched control and the absence of institutional mechanisms or elite opposition capable of forcing removal before the next party congress. Realistic shifts could still arise from sudden health developments or major internal crises, though none are currently indicated in official proceedings or public signals.
